correctness.rationale: In a fair independently oriented tournament, condition on the root vertex outneighbors O and inneighbors I with D=d; each of d(N-d) crossing edges independently makes one cyclic triangle, yielding T|D=d ~ Bin(d(N-d),1/2). Since D~Bin(N,1/2), posterior B=min(D,N-D) has weights h_b C(N,b)C(q_b,t)2^(-q_b) with q_b=b(N-b). Adjacent posteriors tilt by (q_b-t)/(t+1), monotone increasing in b, giving likelihood-ratio and stochastic order, with strictness for t<=q_{m-1} and at most one terminal plateau when n even. Reversing every edge gives E[D|T]=N/2; decreasing (N/2-b)^2 gives variance contraction, and centered Bernoulli fourth moments give Cov((D-N/2)^2,T)=-N(N-1)/16. Independent posterior calculations for n=3..10 passed exact strict/constant cutoffs and variance formula; finite computations corroborate all-n conditional proof.
